reference.type: vector PDF consulting deck whose signature green reads 2.51:1 on white
reference.notes: The house sets titles and heads in its green at 2.51:1 on 23 pages; contrast precedent comes only with --reference.

brief: Four-page budget impact section for a state budget office: revenue scenarios, sensitivity of the gap to two drivers, recovery path, actions.

expected_behavior.statement: Every page of the delivered deck is status fit and the package validates.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json: every slides[].status == 'fit'; validation_ok == true; `pptx_tools.py validate --render` ok.

expected_behavior.statement: plan.py check passes on the plan the deck was built with, and the build ran with --plan.
Every figure stated in a title, lead-in or callout is computed from the page's own data.
expected_behavior.check: For each stated figure, recompute it from the brief's data; zero mismatches. The agent's figure-check script is present and passes.

expected_behavior.statement: Titles are in the house's register and within its length.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json slides[].title: register verdict 'house register'; characters <= guide.titles max; no two-line title the house never wrote.

expected_behavior.statement: Every exhibit is annotated with at least one move the house uses for that data shape, or the report says why not.
expected_behavior.check: Compare each exhibit's annotations and native emphasis with guide.exhibit_habits.moves_by_data_shape.

expected_behavior.statement: The section's realised variety is at or above the house's 10th percentile deck, or each warning is explained as a deliberate parallel.
expected_behavior.check: deck.build.json repetition.warnings empty, or each named in the final report with its reason.

expected_behavior.statement: chart_defaults_taken is empty or every remaining entry is named in the report as intended.
The agent looked at every render and wrote located findings (element id, what, the change), and stayed within the build cap.
expected_behavior.check: Transcript: one findings list per review round; builds <= 8 per 5 pages; the delivered build is the best kept, not merely the last.

expected_behavior.statement: The final report separates measured, completed-by-judgement and substituted values, and lists what the user must supply.
Every build passes --reference so the house's own ink-on-ground pairs are filed as precedent, and no other low-contrast pair is introduced.
expected_behavior.check: contrast.house_precedent lists the green pairs; contrast.violations empty.

expected_behavior.statement: The sensitivity grid boxes the scenario region the claim rests on.
expected_behavior.check: An outline_box annotation with a table anchor on the relevant cells.

expected_behavior.statement: The house's measured habits for source lines are followed by looking, not by default.
expected_behavior.check: Pages carry source lines where the house's data pages do; no 'no source line' warning left unexplained.
